levels.name: Middle School - 3rd Cycle (3º Ciclo)
levels.qualification: Basic Education Certificate (Diploma de Ensino Básico)

levels.name: Secondary Education (Ensino Secundário)
levels.qualification: Secondary Education Diploma (Diploma de Ensino Secundário)

schools.name: Carlucci American International School of Lisbon (CAISL)
schools.admissions: Application, school records, English assessment interview.
schools.pros: Accredited US diploma, excellent facilities, high university placement rates.
schools.cons: Among the most expensive schools, waitlists for early grades.

schools.name: St. Julian's School
schools.admissions: Cognitive testing, interview, previous school transcripts.
schools.pros: Prestigious reputation, strong bilingual pathway option, excellent location.
schools.cons: Extremely long waitlists, highly competitive entry.

schools.name: Oporto British School (OBS)
schools.admissions: Assessment test, trial day, academic reports.
schools.pros: Oldest British school in mainland Europe, strong community feel, central location.
schools.cons: Limited facility size, no boarding option.

schools.name: CLIP - Oporto International School
schools.admissions: English proficiency evaluation, cognitive tests, interview.
schools.pros: Modern campus, comprehensive sports program, diverse student body.
schools.cons: Relatively large class sizes, high tuition rate.

schools.name: Nobel International School Algarve
schools.pros: Only school offering premium boarding in the Algarve, multi-campus facilities, coastal location.
schools.cons: Boarding costs are substantial, commute from western Algarve is long.

schools.name: Vilamoura International School (CIV)
schools.curriculum: Cambridge International Curriculum & Portuguese National Curriculum
schools.pros: Exceptional bilingual integration, superb language support, highly rated in national rankings.
schools.cons: Tuition increases significantly in secondary grades, no boarding.
